claims.claim: PULSE runs a segmented client-support model with separate phone lines and mailboxes for issuers, processors and merchant acquirers, including a dedicated PULSE Issuer Support line and an account-management mailbox.
claims.title: Client Support | PULSE Network
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Issuer mailbox is still on the discover.com domain after the May 18, 2025 Capital One close; other mailboxes are @pulsenetwork.com.

claims.claim: Discover Debit issuers have their own support line separate from the PULSE issuer line.
claims.title: Client Support | PULSE Network
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: Fraud (DebitProtect) and disputes each have a dedicated helpdesk with its own phone number or mailbox.
claims.title: Client Support | PULSE Network
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Disputes Helpdesk mailbox disputes@pulsenetwork.com is listed for both financial institutions and processors.

claims.claim: Processors and merchant acquirers share one support phone number (800-420-2122) but have separate mailboxes, a processor-portal mailbox and a merchant-acquirer sales mailbox.
claims.title: Client Support | PULSE Network
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: Published PULSE contact hours are business hours in US Central time only; no 24x7 support line, language options or formal SLA are published.
claims.quote: We're available 8am – 5pm CT, Monday through Friday.
claims.title: Connect With Us | PULSE Network
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Absence finding: no SLA, no language list, no after-hours or incident hotline on the public client-support or contact pages. Same hours text appears on the client-support page.

claims.claim: The only published response-time commitment is a two-business-day callback for the web contact form.
claims.quote: A PULSE representative will contact you within two business days
claims.title: Connect With Us | PULSE Network
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Sales-inquiry commitment, not an operational SLA.

claims.claim: Partner portal onboarding is a manual three-step process with credentials issued within five business days.
claims.quote: Receive a User ID and temporary password within 5 business days
claims.title: Log In | PULSE Network
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Full text: 'Complete and submit your registration form / Receive a User ID and temporary password within 5 business days / Log in using your User ID and reset your password'.

claims.claim: Partner Support Services bundles analytics (Debit Dashboard), fraud (DebitProtect), marketing (Marketing Hub), disputes, research and thought-leadership content, rather than a named account-management or SLA programme.
claims.quote: Articles, training, webinars, whitepapers, and industry insights
claims.title: Partner Support Services | PULSE Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Page also names Debit Dashboard ('an interactive platform that provides insight into your transaction data'), Marketing Hub ('custom campaigns, card art and cardholder education materials') and industry-body memberships (EMVCo, US Payments Forum, US Faster Payments Council, American Transaction Processing Coalition, FIDO Alliance, MAG).

claims.claim: PULSE positions its issuer service on responsiveness and disputes support, and offers training and research as its education channel; no academy or certification programme is named.
claims.quote: We offer training, research and insights that help keep you informed
claims.title: Issuers | PULSE Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Also: 'When you call, we answer.' and 'We offer full disputes support for transactions, aligned to industry practices.'

claims.claim: PULSE runs an annual Voice of the Client survey and uses a 2025 issuer quote from it on its homepage as evidence of account contact quality.
claims.quote: they do an excellent job staying in touch with their clients
claims.title: PULSE Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Attributed on page to 'PULSE Issuer, 2025 Voice of the Client Survey'.

claims.claim: Training and events are delivered mainly as recorded webinars and recaps on the content.pulsenetwork.com hub (fraud, debit program performance, Debit Issuer Study), not as a live event calendar.
claims.quote: Want to Level Up Your Debit Program? Watch Our Webinar
claims.title: PULSE Thought Leadership
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Other recaps listed: 'How to Combat the New Reality of Payments Fraud', 'Webinar Reveals Stunning Levels of Sophistication Among Fraudsters', 'Top Takeaways from a Year of Data'. Absence finding: no user conference or academy listed.

claims.claim: News timeline, May 18, 2025: Capital One completed its acquisition of Discover Financial Services, bringing the PULSE network under Capital One ownership.
claims.quote: The Discover®, PULSE®, and Diners Club International® networks will join our suite of offerings.
claims.title: Capital One Completes Acquisition of Discover
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Regulatory approvals (Fed, OCC) April 18, 2025; shareholder approval February 18, 2025. Partner-facing guidance: accounts and relationships 'remain unchanged' at close.

claims.claim: News timeline, 2025: PULSE published the 20th-anniversary edition of its Debit Issuer Study, presented by EVP Steve Sievert in an ON24 webinar.
claims.quote: 2025 Debit Issuer Study: 20 Years of Growth, Transformation, and Opportunity
claims.title: Top Takeaways from a Year of Data
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Presenter named as 'Steve Sievert, PULSE Executive Vice President of Marketing and Brand Management'. Report study page footer still reads 'PULSE, a Discover company' (predates or ignores Capital One close).

claims.claim: News timeline, 2026: PULSE released the 2026 Debit Issuer Study ('The Next Era of Debit'), reporting 4.6% transaction growth and card-not-present at half of debit spend.
claims.quote: The payment method's center of gravity continues to shift from physical to digital use.
claims.title: Debit Issuer Study | PULSE Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Summary page cites transaction volume +4.6% YoY, 35.4 monthly transactions per active cardholder, CNP 50% of debit spend, mobile wallet 17% of transactions, A2A volume +25%. The full report is email-gated on content.pulsenetwork.com ('Fill form to unlock content').

claims.claim: News timeline, June 2026: PULSE's client newsletter 'PULSE Perspectives' flagged agentic-commerce liability and BNPL-on-debit as issuer priorities, and still described PULSE as a Discover company a year after the Capital One close.
claims.quote: Maintaining clear authorization controls and strong governance frameworks will become increasingly important
claims.title: PULSE Perspectives – June 2026
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Also: 'integrate BNPL into existing debit experiences.' Self-description 'a Discover company'.

claims.claim: The public PULSE news-release page has not been updated since August 2024; no releases on the Capital One acquisition, pricing, launches or outages appear there.
claims.quote: PULSE® Study Finds Debit's Importance to Consumers Continues to Increase
claims.title: Insights & News | PULSE Network
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Absence finding: latest listed release is 8/8/2024; prior items are 2023 (FICO extension 8/9/2023, Bankers Helping Bankers 1/26/2023). No incident-communication or status page found.
